Coding X will help you learn programming languages such as Python, Java, C Programming, C++, HTML, and CSS, and more with just 5 minutes a day with the Learn Programming app: Coding X 

Coding X is a one-stop app to support your needs to learn coding and programming. If you're planning to take up a software engineer job or want to excel in your exams then this app is made for you. Learning to code has never been so easy and fun!
Our learn to code app is created using research and collaboration with experts and offers a perfect path to learn programming. You will learn to code like an expert and enjoy it like a game. 

✅ Expertly curated courses 🏆

✅ Coding Made Easy for Beginners

✅ Awesome design and interactions 😻👯

✅ In-demand Tech and IT Courses

✅ Sample Codes and Practice Questions

✅ No Ads 👿

With a vast collection of in-depth courses and the inclusion of the fastest online coding compiler in the world, all your programming needs are bundled in a single app for your daily practice.

What programming languages can you learn with this coding tutor app?

Learn Python 👨🏻‍💻 - Python is an interpreted high-level general-purpose programming language. On this app, you can learn and master the Python programming language from scratch to advanced. You will also create projects in Python. 

Learn Java 👨🏻‍💻 - Java is an object-oriented, general-purpose, high-level programming language. You will learn how to write object-oriented code in Java and many advanced concepts such as Networking, JDBC, Swing, and more. You can later use these Java concepts and implement them in web development, app development, and more. 

Learn C Programming 👨🏻‍💻 - C programming is a powerful general-purpose language. If you are new to programming then C Programming is the best language to start your programming journey.

Learn C++ 👨🏻‍💻 - C++ is used nearly everywhere for everything from systems programming, numerical and scientific computing, web development, writing compilers, console games, desktop applications, and so on. This application will help you learn C++ programming and make you industry ready. 

Learn HTML CSS 👨🏻‍💻- HTML and CSS are the core technologies for web development. This app will teach you web development using technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and more. Master HTML CSS and create amazing websites. 

Learn Hacking 👨🏻‍💻- Do you want to learn Ethical Hacking? This application will teach you Ethical Hacking from scratch with a completely practical approach. 

Used by millions of learners, this app is an accessible and effective way to learn to code in Python, Java, HTML, CSS, C++, etc. These programming lessons are suitable for everyone, even with no prior coding knowledge or experience.

**************************
APP FEATURES
**************************

While we make learning to code easy and fun, here are features that would make us your single choice to learn programming languages -

Programming Courses 🚀: To make your learning more interesting, our experts have created bite-sized and interactive courses in Python, Java, C, C++, etc. which will help you learn programming like never before. It's the best place to learn new concepts.

Compiler 🚀: The fastest online compiler in the world on Android with support to compile and run over 20+ programming languages. Write code in various programming languages directly from your mobile. 

Other Features to improve your programming learning experience includes - 

1. Concept-based illustrations to quickly learn to code in a fun way
2. Interactive learning experience
3. Periodic Updates with new programming examples and course content
4. Live projects and modules where you will make your own applications while learning through the course.

Instead of giving us a lower rating, please mail us your queries, issues, or suggestions at hello@codingx.app, we will be happy to solve them for you :)

Visit our website: www.codingx.app
